## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and how behavior changes. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For solver changes, include geometry,
packing-quality, and reference-output checks. For performance claims, include
baseline commit, environment, methodology, and measurements. For demo changes,
include a screenshot and browser verification.

## Limitations

Note any remaining limitations, compatibility changes, or tradeoffs.
